runtime.$comment: Graceful-shutdown grace period and thread-restart policy. Every key is optional and merged over Config.DEFAULT_RUNTIME, so omitting the block keeps the defaults (10s shutdown, restart on, 5 restarts, 1s→60s backoff).

connectors.$comment: Per-name uniqueness is enforced by Config at load time — 'uniqueKeys' is not a standard JSON Schema keyword and would be silently ignored. Per-protocol options are validated by Config against connectors/<protocol>.schema.json shipped next to each connector module, so adding a connector never touches this file.

algorithms.$comment: Per-name uniqueness is enforced by Config at load time — 'uniqueKeys' is not a standard JSON Schema keyword and would be silently ignored

storage.$comment: Per-name uniqueness is enforced by Config at load time — 'uniqueKeys' is not a standard JSON Schema keyword and would be silently ignored. Per-class options are validated by Config against storage/<class>.schema.json shipped next to each backend module, so adding a storage backend never touches this file.

kind.$comment: Per-kind options are validated by Config against devices/<kind>.schema.json shipped next to each device module, so adding a device never touches this file

devices.$comment: Per-name uniqueness is enforced by Config at load time — 'uniqueKeys' is not a standard JSON Schema keyword and would be silently ignored

services.$comment: Supervised workers that own no devices — the read-only REST API is the first. Per-name uniqueness is enforced by Config at load time — 'uniqueKeys' is not a standard JSON Schema keyword and would be silently ignored. Per-class options are validated by Config against services/<class>.schema.json shipped next to each service module, so adding a service never touches this file. A service is not part of the run's liveness: main waits on connectors only, so a config with services and no connectors exits immediately.
